{{Top|leg}}
"'''Project Meteorite'''" was a theoretical tactic of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] that proposed ramming Imperial [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] through [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] and into the ground of enemy [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and then using the downed ships as staging grounds.
